names.zh-Hans: 奥杜邦水族馆水下隧道

summary.zh-Hans: 奥杜邦水族馆位于新奥尔良市中心密西西比河畔。水下隧道展示鱼类、鳐鱼等礁区生物。
summary.en: Audubon Aquarium stands beside the Mississippi River in downtown New Orleans. Its undersea tunnel displays fish, rays and other reef inhabitants.

summary.zh-Hans: 新奥尔良上城区的奥杜邦公园有橡树、步行道与休闲空间，也有小片湿地水域。
summary.en: Audubon Park in Uptown New Orleans has oak trees, walking paths, recreational space and small swamp areas.

summary.zh-Hans: 甘博是可配米饭食用的浓炖汤，配料可有鸡肉、香肠或海鲜。不同做法也会使用秋葵、芹菜、甜椒和洋葱等。
summary.en: Gumbo is a thick stew served with rice, with versions using chicken, sausage or seafood. Preparations can also include okra, celery, peppers and onions.

summary.zh-Hans: 新奥尔良常见的甜味贝涅饼用面团油炸，再在表面撒糖粉。也存在其他馅料与咸味做法。
summary.en: A familiar sweet New Orleans beignet is fried dough covered with powdered sugar. Other fillings and savoury versions also exist.
